# Lectures

This section introduces the fundamentals of AI,
its application in automotive systems and the
engineering principles required to evaluate AI safety.

## Part I — AI Fundamentals

Understand AI, machine learning, neural networks,
automotive AI applications and autonomous-driving architectures.

## Part II — Autonomous Driving Data

Explore public driving datasets, dataset formats,
metadata and annotations, data quality, coverage and bias,
and data collection, synthesis and augmentation.

## Part III — Safety Principles and Standards

Learn functional safety (ISO 26262), SOTIF (ISO 21448),
AI safety (ISO 8800), and how to reason about hazards,
risks and driving scenarios.
